text:
You're not lonely. You're lazy with who you text.

You got three girls texting you right now. Been going at it for weeks. Zero dates. Zero progress.

You tell yourself one might come around.

Wrong. Every conversation needs ONE goal. A date. A number. Forward momentum. If you can't name the goal in the next 48 hours, you're not connecting. You're just filling the void.

Dead conversations don't get better. They get older.

Cut it. Move on to someone who actually moves.
caption:
Success habits start with clear thinking. If a conversation isn't moving forward, it's stealing your time and your confidence.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
#mindset #datingpsychology #discipline #selfimprovement #mensuccess
